text: the cafe is open from seven in the morning until six in the evening.
a small coffee costs three dollars and a large coffee costs four dollars.
a drink that tastes wrong is replaced for free within one day.
loyalty members get a free drink after ten visits.
delivery is free for homes within two miles of the cafe.
oat milk and soy milk cost nothing extra.
free wifi is offered to every customer who orders a drink.
dogs are welcome on the patio but not inside the cafe.
